title: Sushi roll with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- nori wrap outer -->
  <rect x='20' y='32' width='60' height='52' rx='26' fill='#2d4a3e'/>
  <!-- nori lighter rim -->
  <rect x='22' y='34' width='56' height='48' rx='24' fill='#3d6b58'/>
  <!-- rice body -->
  <rect x='26' y='38' width='48' height='40' rx='20' fill='#fff4e0'/>
  <!-- rice texture dots -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='48' r='2' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='1.5' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='46' r='2' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='62' r='2' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='70' r='2' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='68' r='1.5' fill='#f0e0c8'/>
  <!-- salmon filling top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='16' ry='7' fill='#ff8a5c'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='43' rx='12' ry='5' fill='#ffaa7a'/>
  <!-- cucumber slice -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='56' r='6' fill='#5ec46a'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='56' r='3.5' fill='#a8e6a8'/>
  <!-- avocado slice -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#b8d95e'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='58' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#e0f0a0'/>
  <!-- happy eyes -->
  <path d='M38 58 Q41 53 44 58' stroke='#5a3a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M56 58 Q59 53 62 58' stroke='#5a3a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='64' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ffb0b0'/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M44 66 Q50 74 56 66' stroke='#5a3a2a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
